data.one_liner: Take in-person payments using Square hardware in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to accept in-person payments using Square hardware devices. It supports initializing and authorizing the SDK, managing reader connections, processing card payments, and handling reader settings.
use_when: You need to accept physical card or contactless payments using Square hardware readers.
Your mobile application targets iOS 17.1+ and Android API 28+ with native Square SDK integration.
avoid_when: You only need to process online in-app purchases or subscriptions.
You are using older operating system versions that do not meet the minimum SDK requirements.
strengths: Official integration for Square mobile payments hardware.
Comprehensive feature set supporting payment processing, card entry methods, and reader management.
weaknesses: Requires specific modern native build requirements (such as AGP 9.1.0+ and Gradle 9.3.1+ on Android, iOS 17.1+).
Limited to specific supported currencies (AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and USD).
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration for Square Mobile Payments SDK on both Android and iOS, proper device permissions (such as microphone and bluetooth/device permissions), and meeting strict minimum OS and build tool versions.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are processing payments through Stripe instead of Square hardware.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Adyen as your payment gateway instead of Square.
